results.question: Show me my total spending per month in 2025 as a line chart.
results.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  month
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 200

results.question: Show my grocery spending per quarter in 2025, split into supermarket, bakery and drugstore, as a stacked bar chart.
results.sql:
SELECT
  quarter,
  topic,
  total_eur
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
      THEN '2025-Q1'
      WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30'
      THEN '2025-Q2'
      WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
      THEN '2025-Q3'
      ELSE '2025-Q4'
    END AS quarter,
    COALESCE(category, 'Needs review') AS topic,
    ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE
    amount < 0
    AND category IN ('Groceries')
    AND (
      subcategory IN ('Supermarket', 'Bakery', 'Drugstore')
    )
    AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    quarter,
    topic
) AS grouped
ORDER BY
  quarter,
  topic
LIMIT 200

results.question: Wie haben sich meine Ausgaben im Jahr 2025 Quartal fuer Quartal aufsummiert? Zeig mir den Verlauf.
results.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (
      STRFTIME('%Y', booked_on) = '2025'
    )
    AND (
      STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '03'
    )
    THEN 1
    WHEN STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '06'
    THEN 2
    WHEN STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '09'
    THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS quarter,
  CASE
    WHEN (
      STRFTIME('%Y', booked_on) = '2025'
    )
    AND (
      STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '03'
    )
    THEN 1
    WHEN STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '06'
    THEN 2
    WHEN STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '09'
    THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END + 3 AS month_of_quarter,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (
          STRFTIME('%Y', booked_on) = '2025'
        )
        AND (
          STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '03'
        )
        THEN -amount
        WHEN STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '06'
        THEN -amount
        WHEN STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) <= '09'
        THEN -amount
        ELSE -amount
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS cumulative_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  quarter,
  month_of_quarter
ORDER BY
  quarter,
  month_of_quarter
LIMIT 200

results.sql: WITH monthly_totals AS (SELECT half, month_of_half, SUM(amount) AS total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN strftime('%m',booked_on,BEFORE'2026-01-01','Y')<=6 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS half, CAST(strftime('%m',booked_on,'Y')ASINTEGER)-CASE WHEN strftime('%m',booked_on,'Y')<=6 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN strftime('%m',booked_on,'Y')>=7 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END AS month_of_half, amount FROM transaction_view WHERE strftime('%Y',booked_on)='2025' AND amount<0) GROUP BY half, month_of_half) SELECT month_of_half, half, SUM(total)*(-1) OVER(PARTITION BY half ORDER BY month_of_half ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_eur FROM (SELECT 'Erstes Halbjahr' AS half, 1 AS month_of_half FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Erstes Halbjahr', 2 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Erstes Halbjahr', 3 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Erstes Halbjahr', 4 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Erstes Halbjahr', 5 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Erstes Halbjahr', 6 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Zweites Halbjahr', 1 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Zweites Halbjahr', 2 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Zweites Halbjahr', 3 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Zweites Halbjahr', 4 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Zweites Halbjahr', 5 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'Zweites Halbjahr', 6 FROM DUAL) t JOIN monthly_totals m ON (t.half = m.half AND t.month_of_half = m.month_of_half) ORDER BY half, month_of_half
